Question
========
Explain the following concept, spelling out the acronym first if there is one. Give its definition and its usage, and if it has several usages, its most important one.

**RISC**

Solution
========
Reduced Instruction Set Computer. A small, regular, fixed size instruction set where only load and store access memory. Its most important consequence is a much simpler and more easily pipelined implementation.
